map.路线平面设计需按设计速度确定平曲线最小半径，半径过小会导致离心力过大、行车不稳，: Route geometric design must fix the minimum horizontal curve radius by design speed; too small a radius gives excessive centrifugal force and unstable driving, so R ≥ V²/[127(e+f)] must be met.
map.弯道设超高（外侧抬高）以抵消部分离心力，超高率 e 与横向力系数 f 共同决定所: Superelevation on curves (raising the outside) offsets part of the centrifugal force; the superelevation rate e and the lateral force coefficient f together set the required radius — compare against the code minimum radius table (e.g. 125 m for 60 km/h).
map.缓和曲线（超高过渡段）长度 Ls = B·e·p，连接直线与圆曲线，保证超高平顺: Transition curve (superelevation transition) length Ls = B·e·p connects the tangent to the circular curve, ensuring a smooth superelevation transition that aids drainage and comfort, and must be counted together with the circular curve length Lc = R·α in the total curve length.

: horizontal curve radius R = V²/[127(e+f)] = 60²/[127×(0.06+0.15)] = 3600/[127×0.21] = 3600/26.67 ≈ 135.0 m.
Code minimum radius (60km/h)=125 m, R=135≥125 → satisfied.
Circular curve length Lc = R·α(rad) = 135.0×(60×π/180) = 135.0×1.0472 ≈ 141.4 m.
Transition curve length Ls = B·e·p = 7.5×0.06×125 = 56.2 m.
Tangent length T = R·tan(α/2)+Ls/2 = 135×tan30°+28.1 ≈ 77.9+28.1 = 106.1 m; external distance E ≈ 21.9 m.
Total curve length = Lc+2Ls ≈ 141.4+112.4 = 253.9 m.
map.超高率 e 和横向力系数 f 怎么取？: How are the superelevation rate e and lateral force coefficient f chosen?
map.e 一般取 2%~10%（不超过最大超高，如 8%~10% 依地区冰冻条件），f: e is typically 2%~10% (not exceeding the maximum superelevation, e.g. 8%~10% depending on local icing conditions), and f is the lateral force coefficient acceptable to passengers (usually 0.10~0.15). The larger each is, the smaller the required radius — but too large e hurts drainage and too large f makes passengers uncomfortable, so balance per the code.
map.最小半径表里的 125m/250m 怎么来的？: Where do 125 m / 250 m in the minimum radius table come from?
map.规范按设计速度给出设超高最小半径，本质由 R=V²/[127(e+f)] 反算并: The code gives the minimum radius with superelevation by design speed, essentially back-calculated from R=V²/[127(e+f)] and rounded (e.g. for 60 km/h take e+f≈0.17 giving about 168 m, rounded to 125 m with a safety reserve).
